meta.notes: POST /webhook/enrich-individual (or Daily Sweep) — SPOTTER social enrichment. Calls maigret-api (username search) + linkedin-api (name/company lookup) sidecars directly and writes SocialProfile nodes + HAS_PROFILE edges via the Flowsint API. Scope: real people (first+last name) OR is_high_value; machine/service accounts skipped. Bounded per run (SOCIAL_MAX_PER_RUN, default 12) and incremental via the social_enriched flag. Optional body: {entity:{id}} for a single node, {company} to bias LinkedIn match, {social_regions:['us','ru','cn']} for regional platform coverage. Replaces the old broken Gravatar/Breach/Maigret/LinkedIn httpRequest fan-out (placeholder flow IDs). social_regions are Maigret site-DB tags and are ADDITIVE — each region is an extra sweep on top of the global top-sites pass, because the major platforms (GitHub/Instagram/Twitter/LinkedIn/Facebook) carry no country tag and a region filter would drop them all; a body-less run falls back to SOCIAL_DEFAULT_REGIONS. After discovery, each new profile URL is mined by socid-extractor via maigret-api POST /extract (identifiers, real name, bio, cross-platform links) onto the SocialProfile node as socid_* extras. Direct mode only — the plugin-ownership branch returns before any of it. This is also the one workflow besides WF13 that honours the proxy/opsec envelope, which matters because the regional sweeps probe VK/Odnoklassniki/Yandex/Weibo.
